in_sanskrit.name: Sunit

in_marathi.name: Sunit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sunit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sunit is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning sun. The name Sunit is a symbol of brilliance, power, and intelligence. It is believed that the bearer of this name will radiate with the energy and power of the sun.
